description: tractat-us org-wide Renovate defaults, secret-free and public so that PUBLIC repos can extend them. Repos extend this via "local>tractat-us/renovate-config".

packageRules.description: Auto-merge all non-major updates once CI passes; majors stay manual. Requires the extending repo to have a required status check — otherwise this merges ungated.
Skip internal tractat-us packages — they live on GitHub Packages and Renovate cloud has no creds. We publish them ourselves, so manual bumps are fine.
Hold Gradle wrapper upgrades for 30 days so AGP/Kotlin compatibility settles before we move.
Never auto-merge Compose. A green CI run does not cover layout, so these need a WASM-preview or roborazzi look before they land. Overrides the non-major automerge rule above.
AGP majors are disruptive (Kotlin/Compose compat, deprecations). Don't open a PR until someone ticks the box on the Dependency Dashboard.
